description: Pyth Price History. Calls only GET /v4/oracle/pyth/pricefeeds/{priceFeedAddress}/price-ts and returns that response. Solana API endpoint for fetching Pyth oracle price time series data on Solana. Get historical price snapshots with confidence intervals for any Pyth price feed.

limit.description: Limit of the number of records to return

priceFeedAddress.description: Typed Solana public key identifier used across request parameters and response fields. Path parameter for /v4/oracle/pyth/pricefeeds/{priceFeedAddress}/price-ts.

resolution.description: Enumeration of supported resolution deprecated values for time range or aggregation configuration.

timeEnd.description: End time of the data to return (unix timestamp)

timeStart.description: Start time of the data to return (unix timestamp)

name: get-pyth-price-history
title: Pyth Price History
